Upstream defaults the timeout to -1, WAIT FOREVER; this helper drives the executor COOPERATIVELY while it probes, so RFC-0021 forbids an unbounded wait (it would starve every other entity on a single-threaded transport), and the budget is unsigned, so there is no value to port -1 to. Held by `packages/api/nros-cpp/tests/compile/ros2_refuse_unbounded_wait_probe.cpp`, which W9 REPOINTED at this class: left on `rclcpp::Client<S>` it would have failed on "no member named 'wait_for_service'" — non-zero, and not the refusal — which is the "broke for another reason" the lane's grep exists to catch.
